official_data_source.source_name: NCBI Taxonomy E-utilities taxonomy lineage records

target_variable.name: lowest_common_ancestor_tax_id
target_variable.extraction_rule: Hide pairwise lowest-common-ancestor targets until lineage-derived predictions are materialized from locked visible taxon identifiers and permitted lineage prefixes.

formula_requirement.formula_or_model: Lowest-common-ancestor replay over locked NCBI Taxonomy lineage arrays with pairwise tree-distance scoring declared before target opening.

incumbent_comparator_requirement.prediction_rule: Predict the most frequent visible-panel ancestor at the declared rank without reading hidden pairwise lowest-common-ancestor targets.
incumbent_comparator_requirement.required_material_margin: lineage replay accuracy and tree-distance residual must beat the rank-only baseline on the same hidden taxon pairs

uncertainty_requirement.rule: Bind the NCBI taxonomy snapshot date, lock hash, and accepted synonym/version policy before target opening.

residual_requirement.formula: absolute tree-distance between predicted and observed lowest-common-ancestor nodes over hidden taxon pairs
residual_requirement.superiority_rule: mean tree-distance residual must be lower than comparator residual and exact LCA accuracy must be higher than comparator accuracy

negative_control_requirement.rule: lineage-shuffled and rank-only controls must score materially worse than the preregistered lineage replay

falsifier_requirement.trigger: hidden LCA target leaks into visible inputs, N<20, NCBI snapshot or lock hash is missing, residual does not beat comparator, or synonym/version policy is changed after target opening

current_evidence.reason: No locked NCBI Taxonomy lineage snapshot, pairwise target projection, scorer, or strict evidence pack exists for this coverage class.
